correctness.rationale: For the explicit phase gauge, BB*=K is a strictly positive tridiagonal backbone operator away from 0, pi and 2pi; an endpoint absorber observes all nonzero backbone modes. Analytic perturbation of the distal +/-i sqrt(2) oscillator pair gives end-to-sink amplitude squared 2g^(2L)/(gamma^2 4^(L-1)), and physical norm tending to 2; exact energy dissipation gives decay rate g^(2L)/(gamma 4^(L-1)). The pair exhausts the leading integrated survival, while remaining modes are lower-order; the terminal caging point gives no absorption. 204 checks on the standalone program corroborate the formulas but are not the infinite-length proof.

The exponent increases precisely by two for each additional plaquette, with a sharp model-dependent constant. This is a physically motivated transport-tolerance result beyond the known half-flux localization description.
